description.purpose: The one model call of the design lane: it turns a briefed request into a draft manifest. `provider` names the WIRE PROTOCOL, not the vendor, so any OpenAI-shaped endpoint serves -- including the stub the scenario suite starts, which is why the composed class is provable at zero cost. The system tree has a third slot since GH #485: `budget`, rendered fresh by the fan-in on every re-briefing rather than parked with the instructions -- it says which round this is, how many are left, and that the last one is offered no tools at all. It is deliberately NOT in `system_order`: `concat_system_prompt` appends the slots that are not named there after the ones that are, so the budget lands LAST in the prompt -- which is where a rule about THIS round belongs -- and the declared order stays the two slots every other shipped llm cell declares.
description.not_in_scope: No parsing and no trust: whatever it answers is read by `normalise` before it becomes a manifest. And no boot-time demand: all three variables carry an EMPTY default. This hive travels inside the OS shell, and a shell that could not be grown without a model credential would make the FAST LANE -- which asks no model at all -- conditional on one. A colony with no composer configured still rewires an edge; what it cannot do fails at call time, loudly, and not at boot. The completion budget is 32768, and it is a CEILING rather than a spend: a completion is billed by what it produces, so the only thing the cap buys is room to answer in ONE turn -- and what this cell answers with is a whole manifest, up to `normalise`'s declaration cap, which for a rendered level is thousands of tokens of JSON. A cap that is too small does not save the call, it truncates it: `finish_reason: length` on a half-written JSON object is read by `normalise` as `no_manifest_in_answer`, which is a round paid for and nothing delivered. The one thing that DID make a large ceiling expensive was deliberation, because a reasoning model spends the ceiling first and bills all of it -- measured on a design build's writing round: the entire budget spent on reasoning, `finish_reason: length`, content empty, 0.39 USD. With `reasoning` declared off (below) that spend has no producer left, so the ceiling now costs nothing it does not deliver. And no deliberation for its own sake (GH #498): `reasoning` is declared OFF, because this is the one llm cell whose whole product is a JSON document and nothing in this hive reads `message.reasoning`. Left unsent, the field hands the decision to the provider's default -- measured against a hosted Sonnet-class model on a design build's writing round, that default returned 967 completion tokens of which 965 were reasoning and a content of "", which `normalise` reads as `no_manifest_in_answer`: paid for, nothing delivered. The same call with the block declared answered with the manifest in 744 tokens. A build that wants the deliberation turns it back on where every other tuning decision in this hive is made -- `override_params` addressing this cell and this param.
